customer_acme: Hey — since the promotion to semantic-2026-03 (yesterday ~18:12 UTC) our webhook consumer started throwing JSON.parse errors. Happened on 3 requests in the last hour, fails consistently.
customer_acme: Example response copied from webhook (raw body):
```json
{"id":"abc123","response":{"status":"ok","items":[1,2,3]}}
{"meta":{"model":"semantic-2026-03","seq":42}}
```
emma_support: Thanks — can you confirm the endpoint (route) and whether you were using streaming/long-poll? Any x-request-id or request-id headers? :ear:
customer_acme: endpoint /v1/generate?mode=json, we call with stream=true. We see x-request-id: rdx-98765 in the Redwood logs.
raj_eng: This looks like a 0x1E (RS/unit-sep) framing char inserted between two JSON objects — historically we used the delimiter '\u001e' for ndjson streaming. Did the promotion change framing behavior? cc @mike_infra
mike_infra: alert-bot: deploy semantic-2026-03 promoted to production at 2026-03-14T18:10Z
mike_infra: We're seeing a spike in parse errors on /v1/generate for json-mode (95p latency up). Logs show responses containing the literal '\u001e' prefixing the second object without a newline: i.e. `...}}\u001e{"meta":...}` which breaks some webhook ingest that expects one JSON object per HTTP response.
emma_support: Can you paste the exact curl/request you used so we can repro locally?
customer_acme: Sure:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"list users","stream":true}' \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=semantic-2026-03&mode=json"
```
raj_eng: Repro steps: run above with stream=true, capture raw body. If you see '\u001e' between objects, it means the runtime emitted the chunk delimiter without the expected ndjson wrapper for non-ndjson clients. Quick mitigation: set stream=false for now or implement a streaming parser that accepts 0x1E separators. We'll open an eng-runtime ticket.
mike_infra: Filed INFRA-3124: 'stream framing: 0x1E inserted in json-mode after semantic-2026-03 promote' — rolling hotfix to strip 0x1E prefix when mode=json and client didn't request ndjson. ETA ~30m. :hammer_and_wrench:
emma_support: Thanks — passing to customer. @customer_acme, can you switch to stream=false as a short-term workaround? We'll ping when the hotfix is live.
customer_acme: switching now, will report back if it clears. thanks!
emma_support: follow-up: hotfix merged to prod canary, monitoring looks stable. will promote globally after 15m. :thumbsup:
raj_eng: note for postmortem: make framing behavior explicit in the API docs and add a 'streaming_format=ndjson|chunked-json' param to avoid ambiguity.
